summary: NOVONIX Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnished with an ASX quarterly activities report disclosing a binding term sheet to divest its Battery Technology Solutions (BTS) business. NOVONIX will retain a 15% equity interest in the cathode technology business, maintaining exposure to future commercialization of its proprietary all-dry, precursor-free cathode synthesis technology. Completion is anticipated in Q2 2026, subject to definitive agreements and customary closing conditions. The transaction is a strategic exit from non-core operations to focus on scaling synthetic graphite production in North America. Watch for definitive agreement execution and any regulatory clearances; the risk-arb angle centers on completion timing and retained equity valuation.
